items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Story Spotlight Released for Switch 2
items.summary: Bandai Namco released a new Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Story Spotlight ahead of its August 28 launch on Nintendo Switch 2.
items.content:
Bandai Namco has released a new Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Story Spotlight video ahead of the game’s August 28 launch on Nintendo Switch 2.

The new version brings FromSoftware’s open-area action RPG to Nintendo’s latest console with the base game, Shadow of the Erdtree, and added content.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition lets Nintendo players enter the Lands Between and follow the path toward the Elden Throne.

The Story Spotlight trailer sets up the game’s broken kingdom, the call of grace, and the danger waiting across its ruins.

The Tarnished Edition includes Shadow of the Erdtree, the expansion that adds the Realm of Shadow and a new chapter tied to the original game’s story.

Players will be able to play through the full Elden Ring package on Switch 2 when the edition launches later this month.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition also includes two new Starting Classes, new character armor, and the ability to customize Torrent.

Bandai Namco says this new content will also be sold separately for Elden Ring on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.

Elden Ring Tarnished Edition is available to pre-order now on Nintendo Switch 2.

items.title: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition Arrives For Switch 2 on August 28
items.summary: The latest trailer for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition shows off all of the content coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28.
items.content:
Posted in: Bandai Namco , Elden Ring , Games , Video Games | Tagged: Elden Ring Tarnished Edition , george r r martin , Hidetaka Miyazaki

The latest trailer for Elden Ring Tarnished Edition shows off all of the content coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 28.

Bandai Namco released a new trailer this week, showcasing the Elden Ring Tarnished Edition ahead of its August 28 release on the Nintendo Switch 2 . As you can see in the video above, this edition comes with the base game, the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, and new content, including two new Starting Classes for players to choose from. As well as new character armor and the ability to customize Torrent, your in-game mount that you travel on. Enjoy the trailer ahead of the game's launch in about three weeks.

Journey through the Lands Between, a new fantasy world created by Hidetaka Miyazaki , creator of the influential Dark Souls video game series, and George R. R. Martin , author of The New York Times best-selling fantasy series, A Song of Ice and Fire . Unravel the mysteries of the Elden Ring's power. Encounter adversaries with profound backgrounds, characters with their own unique motivations for helping or hindering your progress, and fearsome creatures.

items.title: New Multiplayer Steam Soulslike Blends Elden Ring With Arc Raiders
Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2
items.summary: Pre-order available. Explore a breathtaking world full of excitement and mystery.
items.content:
08/11/26 Pre-order now Rise with ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition, launching Aug. 28 on Nintendo Switch 2 The Lands Between—a place of myth, gods, and broken dreams. Long ago, Queen Marika and her divine offspring reigned here, but since the Elden Ring was shattered, the world has fallen into decay. Now, the land whispers for a King.

The “Tarnished,” long exiled, are finally seeing the light of Grace once more. Step into this hauntingly beautiful realm, unravel its ancient mysteries, and rise as the one true Elden Lord.

The ELDEN RING Tarnished Edition game arrives on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system on August 28 .

The Lands Between are part of a vast continent, where magnificent open fields and huge dungeons with complex three-dimensional designs are seamlessly connected. As you explore, the joy of discovering unknown and overwhelming threats awaits you.

Mastery of the terrain and knowledge of its secrets can help you overcome enemies and defeat formidable bosses—or lead invading players into traps.

The founding mythology of Elden Ring was written by George R. R. Martin and adapted into a rich multilayered story. Intersecting goals and desires between the characters create an intense narrative that weaves throughout the Lands Between. The events of the game can unravel in many ways—depending on your interventions.

Combat is simple to learn yet offers hidden depths of dexterity. As you seek to become the Elden Lord, you’ll need to explore the balance between attacking, avoiding damage, using a wide variety of weapons, spells, summons, and perfecting your timing to take advantage of your opponents’ weaknesses.

In addition to customizing the appearance of your character, there are countless ways to combine the weapons, armor, usable items, and magic that you equip. You can develop your character according to your play style.

No matter if you prefer bold physical confrontation, tactical spellcasting, or the subtle art of stealth, you’ll be able to find gear that supports your choices.

Traverse together with other Nintendo Switch 2 players. You can play with up to two other Tarnished as your cooperative teammates, either by inviting them using a shared password or by summoning them from a pool of nearby community members.

There are also ample opportunities to face off against other players, either through co-op invasions, invited duels, or the many player battle options available in the three Colosseums.

If you’d like to learn more or begin your journey to the Lands Between by pre-ordering the Tarnished Edition, please check out the link below.

items.content:
Just 17 days remain until Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition finally launches on Nintendo Switch 2. Coming to the console on August 28, the game has faced some issues during its porting process. It was originally announced for a 2025 release before being delayed to this year, with its release date eventually confirmed for the end of this month.

To build anticipation for the launch, Bandai Namco has released a new trailer focused on the console version, showcasing new footage of the game running on Nintendo’s new hardware.

Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to wield the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

• A Vast and Exciting World A vast world where open fields and a variety of situations and massive dungeons, featuring complex three-dimensional designs, are seamlessly connected. As you explore, experience the joy of discovering powerful and unknown threats that await you, bringing a great sense of accomplishment.

• Create Your Own Character In addition to customizing your character’s appearance, you can freely combine the weapons, armor, and magic you equip. Develop your character according to your playstyle, such as increasing your physical strength to become a powerful warrior or mastering magic.

• An Epic Drama Born from a Myth A multilayered story told in fragments. An epic drama in which the various thoughts and motivations of the characters intertwine throughout the Lands Between.

• Unique Online Gameplay That Freely Connects You With Others In addition to multiplayer, where you can directly connect with other players and travel together, the game features a unique asynchronous online element that allows you to feel the presence of other players.

The Nintendo Switch 2 version remains shrouded in mystery, with very little footage revealed so far. Back in June, new footage of the game was shared, and you can check it out in more detail here .

items.title: 8 Essential Fantasy Video Games, Ranked
items.summary: Elden Ring, Shadow of the Colossus, and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim are among the best, most essential fantasy video games ever made.
items.content:
elden ring Image via FromSoftware By Diego Pineda Pacheco Published Aug 6, 2026, 6:54 PM EDT Diego Pineda has been a devout storyteller his whole life. He has self-published a fantasy novel and a book of short stories, and is actively working on publishing his second novel. A lifelong fan of watching movies and talking about them endlessly, he writes reviews and analyses on his Instagram page dedicated to cinema, and occasionally on his blog. His favorite filmmakers are Andrei Tarkovsky and Charlie Chaplin . He loves modern Mexican cinema and thinks it's tragically underappreciated. Other interests of Diego's include reading, gaming, roller coasters, writing reviews on his Letterboxd account (username: DPP_reviews), and going down rabbit holes of whatever topic he's interested in at any given point. Sign in to your Collider account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Listen Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap The fantasy genre is one that has produced not just a few, but numerous of the greatest video games of all time. It's an absolutely foundational cornerstone of gaming as a whole, fantasy staples like Dungeons & Dragons having heavily influenced early game design—and still continuing to have an impact on games being made today. It's one thing to talk about the best fantasy video games of all time, however, and a whole other thing to talk about the ones that are the most essential .

The most essential fantasy video games ever aren't necessarily the very best (though they most often have the quality to claim that honor, too). Rather, they're the most immensely influential and foundational in the history of fantasy gaming 's many subgenres. Anyone who wishes to have an even remotely well-rounded understanding of the genre and its historical importance to the art form of video games ought to play these games at least once in their lives.

Zagreus with his weapon over his shoulder in the video game Hades Image via Supergiant Games The roguelike genre is named after the 1980 video game Rogue , and it traditionally consists of games where players move through procedurally generated rooms, death being permanent and forcing the player to start over, basically from scratch. What Hades does with the genre's rules and tropes, however, is truly special. It's one of those video games without any flaws , a masterpiece that all those who love Greek mythology simply have to check out.

Death in Hades isn't a frustrating part of the gameplay loop, but rather an intricately essential part of the story that transforms the genre's usually-punishing mechanics into an incredibly addictive loop where learning from your mistakes becomes deeply satisfying. Understanding and appreciating the roguelike genre is essential to doing the same for fantasy as a whole, and Hades offers a masterfully fun gameplay loop balanced with a moving story that makes one immediately fall in love with roguelikes.

Image via Nintendo Tabletop game rules were crucial to early fantasy game design, and even just game design as a whole. There are some video game genres that still rely greatly on very similar kinds of rules, one of the most prominent being turn-based tactical RPGs. And as far as that subgenre goes, it doesn't get much better than the Fire Emblem franchise, the Nintendo 3DS' Awakening in particular arguably being the most essential entry.

On Metacritic, it's both the highest-rated 3DS game of all time and the highest-rated game in the entire Fire Emblem franchise . It's the game that literally saved the series, since dwindling sales for previous entries made Nintendo set an ultimatum that if Awakening failed to sell at least 250,000 copies, Fire Emblem would be canceled. In the end, it sold over two million copies more than that. It achieved this through franchise-changing mechanics that made Fire Emblem more fun than it had ever been before, an entertaining story, and a formula that lends the game replayability that's pretty much endless.

False Knight fight from 'Hollow Knight' Image via Team Cherry The Metroidvania is another game genre that has done an awful lot for fantasy gaming over the years. Inspired by the Metroid and Castlevania game franchises, the genre basically consists of pure exploration, constant backtracking, and non-linear progression . And as far as Metroidvanias go, you can't really get anything much more iconic or universally acclaimed than Hollow Knight .

It's one of the best indie video games of all time , a creative triumph whose every element works in flawless conjunction with all the others to deliver an unforgettable action-adventure fantasy experience. There are very few fantasy games with better music, better world-building, better level and boss designs, or more interesting lore than Hollow Knight . It's one of the most iconic games of the 21st century thus far by a decent margin, and that's for good reason.

Wandering about to engage a Colossus in Shadow of the Colossus Few games have ever played a part as prominent as Shadow of the Colossus in the endless debate in favor of video game design being recognized as a true art form. Subverting the traditional chaotic maximalism of action-adventure fantasy games in favor of a slow-burning, minimalist approach, Shadow of the Colossus tells a powerful tale about morality, obsession, and humanity's hubris in their relation to the environment.

The world that the player gets to explore is huge, yet incredibly sparse and quiet, generating profound feelings of melancholy and isolation . This is all intentional. Slaying these ancient, massive creatures isn't only a constantly awe-inspiring gameplay loop full of satisfying surprises, but also a profoundly thought-provoking activity that forces the player to wonder what all this destruction is actually achieving.

items.title: What it's like beating Elden Ring twice a week for 4 years: "I think it's the greatest game that's ever been made"
items.content:
Playing FromSoftware's best RPG for a living takes you to some weird places

When you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works .

(Image credit: Bandai Namco) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter FromSoftware is in a curious position. It released Elden Ring, its most successful and arguably best game, and ever since has exclusively released games that are very different to Elden Ring. And yes, that does include Elden Ring Nightreign, an experimental spinoff that cleverly reuses some assets and shrinks the world, then builds a PvE battle royale experience around it.

We've had Armored Core 6 and we've got The Duskbloods coming, but FromSoftware hasn't announced a new single-player dark fantasy RPG of the kind it's known for. This has left many fans revisiting the RPGs FromSoft has already released, most especially Elden Ring and its gargantuan world and DLC. It's hard to think of anybody who has gotten more out of Elden Ring than Bushy, a challenge runner who's beaten this famously long and difficult RPG over 400 times by his best estimate.

On Twitch and YouTube , Bushy is known for completing challenge runs in Elden Ring, and occasionally other games, that put restrictions on how he plays. Across hundreds of clears, he's amassed a huge collection of absurd rule sets. You have the classics, like one-hitting bosses, never dying, never getting hit, always getting hit, or kicking enemies to death. Mods, some of them commissioned by Bushy just for this purpose, also allow for stranger runs with teleportation, mismatched areas and enemies, or randomized items. Then we get to the truly specific stuff, like his most recent video: " Elden Ring But I Can Only Use White Items ".

It was this color-specific video series that pushed me to reach out to Bushy. Man , I thought, this guy has done everything . And it's easy to think that Bushy must be running out of ideas or growing sick of the game by now, but he tells me he's every bit as in love with Elden Ring as he has been for the past "3,500 to 4,000" hours of game time.

"I think it's the greatest game that's ever been made," Bushy says. "I always just have a ton of fun with it. If I didn't have that much fun with it, I wouldn't still be trying to come up with new, inventive ways to beat it. Don't get me wrong, part of that is absolutely that it's my job, and there are external forces that are encouraging me to play Elden Ring. But I think it's honestly more of a blessing than it is a curse."

7 years ago, the first Elden Ring trailer changed my life One Bloodborne player has spent 3,500 hours helping people with one of FromSoftware's hardest bosses Dark Souls isn't "an especially difficult game," former Tekken boss says The release of Elden Ring Nightreign did give Bushy some space to play another game, and the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC was a refreshing injection of new content and items, but he always comes back to the game.

He considers the pessimistic read of his position. "You could look at that in a negative light," he says. "You're playing Elden Ring because you have to, because it's the only thing that makes you money. But that's not really how I look at it. Elden Ring is a game that is big enough, massive enough, deep enough, that has such a breadth of content, that having motivation and a reason to actually play it that much is really quite the blessing. I get to play it a whole lot more than other people do."

Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more

Bushy's putting every last grain of Elden Ring under the magnifying glass. Like a speedrunner, he talks about individual bosses as things to "practice". His videos often see him deliberately rotate through spells, weapons, and items in order to explain and engage with multiple parts of the game rather than simply using the first winning option he can find, and his rule sets regularly lead to interesting discoveries about overlooked items and strategies. I'm reminded of MMO players running self-sufficient accounts, whose self-imposed challenges force them to play the game in novel ways.

His favorite challenge runs are those that dramatically change the game and are "higher effort" overall, like the one where he was teleported to a random checkpoint every five minutes. He also played the game with an aggression mod that made every enemy follow and attack him at all times, with basically no way to lose or avoid aggro. It didn't go well.

Now, Bushy can just throw out obscene sentences like this: "I've on average beaten the game probably twice a week since the game came out." This schedule wasn't immovable, but his channel history bears it out. I've learned not to underestimate FromSoftware fans, but I certainly haven't met anyone else who's rolled credits this many times. Additionally, Bushy says, "the longest I've gone not playing Elden Ring since it came out has probably been like three weeks."

Bushy is certainly looking forward to future FromSoftware games, but somehow reckons he's got more than enough Elden Ring challenge run ideas left in the tank. When he started playing the game for a living, building on years of streaming other games, he was "hopeful" after his early challenges got some attention. "I made lots of very bad videos and got more views than I had ever gotten at the time," he recalls. Elden Ring's massive audience was enough to turn the game into a career for him, not unlike how creators like VaatiVidya make a living by interpreting FromSoftware lore.

items.title: ELDEN RING - RAGING WOLF 1/6 SCALE STATUE
items.summary: Who is the Raging Wolf? Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to
items.content:
Who is the Raging Wolf?

Among the first Tarnished to join the Roundtable Hold was Vargram, a warrior of great skill and ferocity. He acquired the title of the Raging Wolf from the white wolf pelt that flowed from his helm. Vargram sought to become the shadow of one of the Empyreans and built his strength relentlessly as he traveled through fallow Limgrave to the golden city of Leyndell. And yet in spite of all his strength, his armor is now worn by another… An unnamed Tarnished now walks the Lands Between in the skin of the wolf. Does this warrior seek the same fate as Vargram, forever stalking at the side of an Empyrean? Will they uphold the Golden Order or supplant it for some new code? Whatever the destination, woe befall upon any who dare block the path.

The most impressive Elden Ring statue yet

Standing at 33 cm/13 inches, it’s one of the largest character statues ever produced for ELDEN RING. Crafted with the attentive supervision of FromSoftware, this full 1/6 scale figure captures each minute detail with masterful skill. The size allows perfect fidelity to the beautiful and dark fantasy atmosphere of the game, including smears of bloody red across blade of the Bastard Sword and the crest of the Iron Roundshield. From the intricate filigrees of its helm to its whisps of silvered fur blown back by an errant breeze to the humble, dusty cloth wraps protecting the feet of its greaves against the mossy stones of the path to Stoneveil Castle, it’s a portrait of the implacable will of the Tarnished. All these expertly rendered touches from sculpturer Shinya Yamaoka make this statue a perfect match to the most iconic set from one of the most iconic games of this generation.

Where can I get a Raging Wolf Set statue?

Pre-orders for the Raging Wolf 1/6 scale statue can be placed on the official Bandai Namco website. At this time, based on the production estimates of Gecco studio, these stunning PVC/ABS figures will ship to your home in Winter of 2026. If you are a true aficionado of the game, there is no better purchase to bring the world of Elden Ring to your home or office. It’s a timeless piece for your own collection or an impressive gift for a friend or loved one. And one small note, if you have not yet found this set in the Lands Between for your Tarnished, we recommend you seek the aid of Recusant Bernahl at the Volcano Manor.

Place your order for the Raging Wolf statue on the official Bandai Namco Store.

*This product is available on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, the Middle East, India, and the United States.

items.title: ELDEN RING: SHADOW OF THE ERDTREE – Official Vinyl Soundtrack

items.content:
Follow in the foosteps of Miquella once more with this exclusive 2 disc vinyl collection, celebrating the sweeping, emotional journey of Shadow of the Erdtree.

Presented with the reverence merited by a legendary expansion, this premium set is crafted for collectors, audiophiles, and Tarnished who seek to experience the Realm of Shadow through its music.

The Collection

Housed in a full color gatefold sleeve and marked with the symbol of Messmer the Impaler, each vinyl disc is pressed on heavyweight material to ensure optimal durability and warmth of playback. Whether displayed proudly on a shelf or played to relive your own quest, this set is designed as both a collector’s piece and a lasting tribute to one of the most celebrated expansions in modern gaming.

The Artists

Across 18 tracks, the soundtrack transforms the ELDEN RING experience into a powerful standalone odyssey—one carried by orchestral grandeur, ethereal choir work, and the signature melancholy that defines the worlds created by FromSoftware.

A Collector’s Treasure

This official vinyl set is an essential centerpiece for any discerning fan’s collection. Perfect for longtime followers of FromSoftware’s musical legacy or newcomers drawn into the Land of Shadow for the first time. *This vinyl is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia, Middle East, India and the United States

items.title: Discover the ELDEN RING Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp
items.summary: Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING ’s most iconic character. Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique n
items.content:
Summon the legendary warrior into your world with the Blaidd The Half-Wolf Lamp, a handcrafted, LED-powered tribute to one of ELDEN RING’s most iconic character.

Designed for collectors, lore enthusiasts, and Tarnished alike, this unique night lamp captures the tragic loyalty and silent strength of Blaidd, Shadow of Ranni.

The lamp features an LED-illuminated base that reveals glowing rune symbols beneath Blaidd’s feet, evoking the grace-given power that guides Tarnished across the Lands Between. Rising above it, an engraved acrylic summoning panel glows softly when lit, capturing the look and feel of an in-game summon sign and the spirit-calling magic it represents. Powered through a simple USB connection, it offers effortless illumination for any desk, gaming setup, or collector’s display.

"If ever thou shouldst call upon me… I shall come."

Blaidd’s oath echoes still. Now, he stands ready, not for battle, but as a silent guardian of your space.

Bring the moonlit magic of ELDEN RING into your world, one glowing rune at a time.

*This edition is available exclusively on the Bandai Namco Store in Europe, Australia and the United States.

items.content:
To address the security vulnerability announced by Unity Technologies on October 3, 2025, an update to some pre-order bonuses, as well as the artwork & soundtrack application was distributed.

The main game is not impacted by the security vulnerability and the update.

Thank you for your understanding.

The version number of this update shown at the lower right corner of the Title Screen will be as follows:

Further updates will be distributed in the future for you to continue to enjoy ELDEN RING more comfortably.

Please stay tuned for more news by following our social channels or joining us on the official ELDEN RING Discord server.
